fields.description: Bluewaters Bay is a waterfront apartment development between Bluewaters Island and The Beach at JBR. The official collection extends from one-bedroom homes to five-bedroom penthouses. Tower 1 plans distinguish ordinary balcony apartments, promenade-level terraces and split-level penthouse layouts.

overview: Tower 1’s promenade Type 01A has a larger terrace than the regular version. The five-bedroom penthouse spans two levels; its repeated whole-home table is not a separate area for each floor.
research.locationNote: Between Bluewaters Island and The Beach at JBR, Dubai. Confirm the exact building entrance, pedestrian connections and unit orientation; proximity does not automatically confer private beach rights.
research.priceNote: The sold-out Meraas page retains AED 2.85m. Its original sheet lists one-bedroom homes from 2.85m, two from 4.42m and three from 6.61m. These are historical developer guides, not a current quotation or evidence of stock.
research.paymentNote: The original official plan gives 20% booking; 10% June 2023; 10% December 2023; 10% June 2024; 10% December 2024; 10% June 2025; 10% December 2025; 20% July 2027 handover. Past milestones require reconciliation with any remaining transfer balance.
research.handoverNote: The original sheet estimates July 2027. A later Meraas announcement dated 27 January 2025 instead targets Q4 2027, while Property Finder lists March 2027. These are different dated references; obtain the selected unit’s updated contractual date. The headline is withheld.
